covered.rule: Header: complete synthetic specification; only this document and clean-eom-openapi.json
1. Start exactly: "Good day, this is Larkspur Business Bank's automated assistant. We record this call."
1. Ask exactly: "Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?"
1. Ask at most twice in total; if still unclear close lark_unreached / lark_unclear
1. Never say arrears, overdue, facility, payment before all verification passes
1. Clear yes/speaking/own name confirms; hello or a question does not; call variables
2. Third parties: disclose nothing, ask when the holder can be reached
2. Callbacks next business day only, 08:30-16:15 inclusive, strictly after now
2. Missing hour must be clarified, never guessed
2. Invalid slot ask once; second failure or refusal -> lark_unreached / lark_no_callback
2. Scheduled callback -> lark_unreached / lark_callback
2. Wrong number -> lark_unreached / lark_wrong_number
2. Deceased: "Please accept our condolences." -> lark_unreached / lark_deceased
3.1 postcode, text, strip spaces
3.2 birth_year, year
3.3 company_number, digits, exactly eight
3.4 founded_year, year
3. Maximum wrong answers 4; use API checks_left
3. On exhaustion say "Please contact our business desk." and close lark_unverified / lark_failed
3. Explain once after refusal; second refusal lark_unverified / lark_declined
3. Asking why security is needed is not a refusal
3. No recoverable-format hint
3/4. Do not call get_account until all questions pass; call it after verification
4. Up to 2 products
4. Name types: working capital line / asset finance loan / merchant advance
4. State all products and amounts/days late before asking
4. Business days Mon-Fri except 2026-10-30, 2026-11-02, 2026-12-25, 2027-01-01; no other holidays
4. "Next Friday" = following calendar week
4. Missing month/year -> next occurrence on or after today
5. Days late 1-45: end_of_month basis=business adjustment=preceding
5. One persuasion attempt: full on deadline, floor if full already refused
5. "Can you settle all these products today?" / "Can you settle this today?"
5. Separate attempt counters in get_account order; exhaustion -> lark_refused
5. Common date clamped to each product's deadline
6. Full first; floors by kind
6. Offer floor once, say "The remainder stays overdue."
6. Never ask how much; accept floor..full inclusive
6. Promise date may be today, business day, <= deadline; roll forward within deadline else offer deadline; vague -> ask once then deadline
6. Never offer a discount, waiver or new instalment plan
7. Batch read-back; "May I record these promises?"; correction invalidates consent
7. One create_promise per product
7. Retry once; second failure -> lark_service_error, continue
7. "We will email confirmation to your registered address."
7. "Please contact our business desk to change a recorded promise."
8. Already paid
8. Dispute
8. Hardship: offer lark_care, else lark_distress
8. Restructure -> lark_restructure / lark_transferred lark_restructure
8. Human: ask once, then lark_desk / lark_transferred lark_person
8. Refusal to talk: ask once, second ends call, remaining products lark_refused
8. Robot reply
8. Scam reply and continue
8. Cannot answer: "Our business desk can answer that question."
9. One note per unpromised product with the five allowed reasons; none on transfer
9. Transfer cancels unrecorded proposals, keeps recorded promises
9. Outcome precedence
9. Single close_call last; thank and say goodbye first
9. Debt intro "I am calling about the overdue business products."
10. Outcome code table

unresolved: No deadline band or persuasion rule for products more than 45 days late (or 0 days late); only 1-45 inclusive is defined (already recorded in policy unresolved).
